caption: Hi, I'm Kino. I watch your WhatsApp group photos and find your kids in them, all on your own machine.
say: Hi, I'm Kino. I watch your WhatsApp group photos and find your kids in them, all on your own machine.

caption: Faces are detected with SCRFD and matched with AuraFace, locally on the CPU. Nothing leaves your machine except the photo you ask me to forward.
say: Faces are detected with SCRFD and matched with AuraFace, locally on the CPU. Nothing leaves your machine except the photo you ask me to forward.

caption: On first run, choose the admin password. Do this from your local network, before exposing Kino anywhere.
say: On first run, choose the admin password. Do this from your local network, before exposing Kino anywhere.

caption: Next, connect OpenWA. Enter its URL and API key, then use Generate for the webhook secret, and pick the session.
say: Next, connect OpenWA. Enter its URL and API key, then use Generate for the webhook secret, and pick the session.

caption: The phone number is masked, and I register the webhook for you. Now I can receive group photos.
say: The phone number is masked, and I register the webhook for you. Now I can receive group photos.

caption: On the Kids page, add each kid and watch the coverage meter. Auto-save is off by default, so nothing is saved until you decide.
say: On the Kids page, add each kid and watch the coverage meter. Auto-save is off by default, so nothing is saved until you decide.

caption: Matches I am not sure about wait in the Review queue. Confirm, reject, or tell me it's someone else, and I learn from each answer.
say: Matches I am not sure about wait in the Review queue. Confirm, reject, or tell me it's someone else, and I learn from each answer.

caption: References are the faces I compare against. Outliers are flagged, so you can retire the ones that look wrong.
say: References are the faces I compare against. Outliers are flagged, so you can retire the ones that look wrong.

caption: The Gallery shows the photos I identified, grouped by month. Open one to see its kids and group, or remove it from a kid.
say: The Gallery shows the photos I identified, grouped by month. Open one to see its kids and group, or remove it from a kid.

caption: On Groups, choose which chats to watch and map each one to its kids. You can also backfill recent history, so I can start with photos you already have.
say: On Groups, choose which chats to watch and map each one to its kids. You can also backfill recent history, so I can start with photos you already have.

caption: Activity shows how each image was processed, including every face it found and the score it got. It is the place to look when a photo was not saved.
say: Activity shows how each image was processed, including every face it found and the score it got. It is the place to look when a photo was not saved.

caption: The Test page lets you move the threshold sliders and preview the result before enabling auto-save.
say: The Test page lets you move the threshold sliders and preview the result before enabling auto-save.

caption: Who is this? groups unknown faces together. Pick a group, choose the kid, and those faces become references.
say: Who is this? groups unknown faces together. Pick a group, choose the kid, and those faces become references.

caption: In Settings, set where saved photos are forwarded, and turn on sending them with a caption. You can also choose the chat and schedule for the review digest.
say: In Settings, set where saved photos are forwarded, and turn on sending them with a caption. You can also choose the chat and schedule for the review digest.

caption: Use the toggle to switch between light and dark. The layout also fits a phone screen.
say: Use the toggle to switch between light and dark. The layout also fits a phone screen.

caption: That's the tour. Thanks for watching!
say: That's the tour. Thanks for watching!
